title: Prove hosted CRM and lab account integration end to end
description:
As an operator, I want acceptance evidence separated from source completion.

Feature: Prove hosted CRM and lab account integration end to end
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given the shipped central service and authorized lab runtime roles
    When the reviewed hosted flow is accepted
    Then account selection permission denial persistence conflict and customer-success handoff are demonstrated while unapproved intake and onboarding remain disabled

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Priority 2 in parallel with priming: prove Google login, account selection and fresh account-scoped permissions in Cyclotron Lab using central Prospectus, then invitations and basic contact/demo inquiry. Billing/credits design is not a dependency of the basic account path.

Feature: Hosted central account access in Cyclotron Lab
  Scenario: Login select and reload
    Given an approved Google identity and account/product membership
    When the user signs in to Cyclotron Lab, selects an account and reloads
    Then the selected authorized account and its permitted lab data remain available through the central service
  Scenario: Denied and revoked access
    Given an unenrolled user, wrong account/product or revoked membership
    When the user opens or reloads the lab or submits a pending operation
    Then the request is denied without account creation grant inference or cross-account data
    And stale selection/cache does not retain access

Use centralprospectus.anth.us in papyrus-production; lab.cyclotron.anth.us consumes it through reviewed roles/temporary credentials. Account administration, membership, product permission and CRM staff access remain distinct. Shipped account-selection source is not reopened; remaining hosted denial/revocation/reload acceptance is recorded here. Dependencies: PapyrusPPY-58f107; Cyclotron shared account/runtime adapter. Existing runtime/permission owners preserve exact approval scope; no new long-lived keys or persistent grants follow from this plan.

Do not close solely on source CI: retain browser/API evidence of login, account selection, reload, wrong-scope denial and post-revocation denial. Test shared central account policy and both trusted Lab runtime paths without granting access through generic admin roles.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.
